build_distribution_agent: build a DistributionAgent subclass that implements get_next_step_distribution to return scored state updates
sample_next_step: sample next steps from a DistributionAgent distribution with a specified number of candidates
reweight_distribution: reweight a DistributionAgent distribution using temperature, top_k, and top_p parameters
create_reweighted_agent: create a ReweightedDistributionAgent wrapping a DistributionAgent with temperature and top_p settings
compute_softmax: compute softmax probabilities from a numpy array of log scores using logsumexp normalization
